what: A photo band at 72.5% height in the center of the pinned panel is hidden by two background-colored covers above and below. When the section top comes 250px above screen center, tied to scroll (.25s late), the covers fold open upward and downward and the band settles down a little, then flows sideways by its overflow width, and finally the band exits upward — time ratio open 2 · flow 6 · exit 2, no curve. The section height sets itself as (top and bottom margins + overflow width)×2. Below 800px it is not pinned and stacks vertically

options.[data-fx-part=rail]: Panel holding the bands that moves up and down (required)
options.lead: How many px earlier than screen center to start, default 250
options.open · run · out: Opening · flowing · draining time ratio, default 2 · 6 · 2

use: …slot…
